newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London mixed, HSBC eases.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London mixed, HSBC eases.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London ended mixed on Thursday, with the overall index easing on the back of profit-taking in HSBC Holdings, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index ended 64.10 points lower at 15,642.19. HSBC closed at HK$274, down from its Hong Kong close of HK$279.

"The market was really strong in Hong Kong, on the back of Hong Kong bank (HSBC) yet again," one dealer said. "It probably got pushed up a little too far by the close and there was a bit of profit taking in London in Hong Hong bank. That's why the index in London is down."
But dealers said trade had been relatively thin overall and other stocks, such as property counters, were better bid in London than at their Hong Kong close.
The Hang Seng soared to a record close of 15,706.29 on Thursday, up 260.27, with a rampant HSBC driving the advance.
